senses.gloss:
yuyujāná-sapti, a., dessen Rosse [sápti] angeschirrt [yuyujāná Part. Perf. von yuj] sind.
-ī [du.] (aśvínā) {503,4}.

yúyudhi, a., streitbar, kampfbereit [von yudh].
-ayas {941,4} (raṇvā́sas); śū́rās {85,8}.

yū́yudhi, a., m. [Pad. yúyudhi, Prāt. 〔587〕], streitbar, Kriegsheld [von yudh, vgl. yúyudhi].
-is {975,4}.

yū́yuvi, a. [Pad. yúyuvi, Prāt. 〔585〕], verscheuchend, entfernend [von 2. yu].
-is {404,3} dviṣás yuyotu 〰.
